title: Production comedy script
script: Right, let’s introduce the latest darling of open source. AnalystTom’s veed_hack. A roast generator with zero stars. One contributor. Five languages. That’s not a team; that’s a solo founder who opened every file type to keep them company. It has a .lavish folder but no declared license, no description, and no audience. It runs production-comedy commands and evaluation pipelines while attracting zero forks. The product is designed to critique other projects while remaining invisible itself. The most honest review ever written.
